content:
Podcaster and comedian Andrew Schulz is once again denouncing President Donald Trump after interviewing him and voting for him in 2024.

Schulz spoke about the president’s failures during an episode of his and Charlemagne tha God’s “Brilliant Idiots” podcast released over the weekend.

“I don’t necessarily think it was a blue wave,” Charlemagne said of Democrats’ midterm wins. “I just think it was a complete rebuke of the last decade of MAGA. That’s all.”

“I mean, when South Carolina goes blue, when Kansas goes blue, when Mississippi goes blue, when fucking Texas goes blue, you have completely, without a shadow of a doubt, blew it as a president,” he said before Schulz jumped in.

“It’s the greatest failure of a president of our lifetime,” he declared, later calling Trump’s presidency “the greatest fall from grace, miscalculation, the greatest failure.”

Most politicians make promises they don’t keep, Schulz acknowledged, but he said that “what is more rare is literally doing the exact opposite of the things that you campaign on, to a level that nobody’s seen before and a level of corruption and cronyism that has never been seen in Western democracy.”

Schulz was once a steadfast supporter of Trump and voted for him in the 2024 election.

He also platformed the president on his popular podcast, “Flagrant.” His nearly 90-minute interview with Trump got well over 9 million views.

“I voted for Trump, yeah, but my vote was more like I voted against a Democratic institution that I feel was stripping the democratic process from its constituents,” he shared. “I didn’t like the way things were going, and Kamala was saying, yeah, we’re going to keep doing that.”

“I grew up in a fucking dance family and an arts family in New York City. Do you really think I’ve been right-wing my entire life? No, I’ve been a Democrat my entire life,” he said.

But Schulz changed his tune once Trump was elected, telling The Daily Beast that people would regularly DM him about the president’s actions.

“There’ll be people that they’ll DM me like, ‘You see what your boy’s doing? You voted for this.’ I’m like, ‘I voted for none of this,’” he said.

“He’s doing the exact opposite of everything I voted for. I want him to stop the wars — he’s funding them. I want him to shrink spending, reduce the budget — he’s increasing it. It’s like everything that he said he’s going to do — except sending immigrants back, and now he’s even flip-flopped on that, which I kind of like.”
